questions.question: Arvind gives half of his monthly salary to his wife for household expenses. He spends Rs.2,500 on his personal expenses. The saving he manages per month is 3/7 of his monthly salary. What is Arvind's per month salary?
questions.solution:
Given,

Let the salary of Arvind per month = x

He gives half of his salary to his wife, remaining salary = x - {{x} over 2}

 

He spends Rs. 2,500 on his personal expenses, remaining salary = x - {{x} over 2} - 2500

The saving he manages per month is 3/7 of his monthly salary,3 /7 th of his salary.

So,

x - {{x} over 2} - 2500 = (3/7)x

x - 5000 = (6/7)x

(1/7)x = 5000

x = 35000

 

Hence, “35,000” is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

1. Few boys play hockey.

2. Few girls don't play badminton.

3. Everyone plays **either **hockey or badminton.

Conclusions:

I. Boys don't play badminton.

II. Few girls play hockey.

III. No one plays **both** hockey and badminton.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follows.

questions.solution:
Conclusion I: This does not follow, because it is mentioned in the third statement that everyone plays either hockey or badminton.

Conclusion II: This follows, because it is mentioned in the statements that few girls don’t play badminton, so they play hockey.

Conclusion III: This follows, because it is mentioned that everyone plays either hockey or badminton.

Hence, only conclusions II and III follows.

questions.question:
Select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

2, 7, 5, 2, 3, 1, ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

The third number is the subtraction of the first and second number,

|7 - 2| = 5

The fourth number is the subtraction of second and third numbers,

|7 - 5| = 2

The fifth number is the subtraction of a third and fourth number

|5 - 2| = 3

The sixth number is the subtraction of the fourth and fifth number,

|3 - 2| = 1

similarly,

The seventh number is the subtraction of the fifth and sixth numbers,

|3 - 1| = 2

Hence, 2 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which of the following order of numbers will make the below equation correct?

36 × 5 - 18 ÷ 6 + 2 = 78
questions.solution:
The original equation is,

36 × 5 - 18 ÷ 6 + 2 = 78

Verifying the options using BODMAS rule,

Option 1 → 5 × 6 - 36 ÷ 18 + 2

Using BODMAS rule,

5 × 6 – 2 + 2 = 78

30 – 2 + 2 is not equal to 78

Option 2 → 36 × 2 - 18 ÷ 6 + 5

Using BODMAS rule,

36 × 2 – 3 + 5 = 78

72 – 3 + 5 is not equal to 78

**Option 3 → 18 × 5 - 36 ÷ 2 + 6**

**Using BODMAS rule,**

**18 × 5 – 18 + 6 = 78**

**90 – 18 + 6 = 78**

**96 – 18 = 78**

**78 = 78**

Option 4 → 5 × 2 - 18 ÷ 6 + 36

Using BODMAS rule,

5 × 2 – 3 + 36 = 78

10 – 3 + 36 is not equal to 78

Hence, option is the correct answer.

questions.question: While traveling by bus, a man spent Rs. 60 more than 10 times the fare he paid for an auto rickshaw. The total amount spent by him is 13 times the fare he paid for an auto rickshaw. What total amount of money was spent on Bus as well as Auto rickshaw by the man?
questions.solution:
Let, Man spend fare for auto rickshaw = a ------(i)

Then, Man spend fare for Bus = 10a + 60 Rs ------(ii)

Total amount spent by him = 13a ------(iii)

According to question,

Eq (i) + Eq (ii) = Eq(iii)

a + 10a + 60 = 13a

2a = 60

a = 30

Man spend fare for auto rickshaw = 30 Rs

Man spend fare for Bus = 300 + 60 = 360 Rs

Total amount of money was spent on Bus as well as Auto rickshaw by the man = 360 + 30

= 390 Rs

Hence, 390 is the correct answer.

questions.question: Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd letter-cluster.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/255a22c958f21c44ea260ae89ee168d39745a649cb733dc79cbd17e567acb576.png] 

The pattern followed is,

**Sum of positional value of 1st and 2nd alphabet = Positional value of 3rd alphabet.**

J(10) + P(16) = Z(26)

**M(13) + Q(17) = S(19)**

D(4) + L(12) = P(16)

F(6) + H(8) = N(14)

All follow the same pattern, except ‘MQS’.

Hence, “MQS” is the odd letter cluster.
